"""Plot certified ingredients and the remaining source-phase discrepancy."""
from fractions import Fraction as F
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

from smatrix_bootstrap.amplitudes import conformal_z
from smatrix_bootstrap.impact_closed_form import certify_impact_profile_closed_form


def main():
    path=Path('results/gauge_global_ingredients_witness.json');report=json.loads(path.read_text())
    sol=report['solution'];degree=report['config']['scattering']['degree']
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(13,3.8),layout='constrained')
    colors=['#1768ac','#d16b20','#7e4585']
    bs=np.geomspace(.001,100,180)
    values=[]
    for b in bs:
        audited=certify_impact_profile_closed_form(b,sol['coefficients'],degree,normalization='threshold')
        values.append([c['enclosure']['midpoint_approximate'] for c in audited['channels']])
    for i,color in enumerate(colors):axes[0].loglog(bs,np.array(values)[:,i],color=color,label=f'I = {i}')
    axes[0].set(xlabel=r'$b$',ylabel=r'$b^2 e^{2b}H_I(b)/(2\pi)$',title='All-b joint condition: certified')
    axes[0].legend(fontsize=8);axes[0].grid(alpha=.2)
    pion=report['config']['inputs_GeV']['pion_mass_GeV']
    energy=np.geomspace(1.2,100,500);s=(energy/pion)**2;z=conformal_z(s);x=8/s-1
    for j,(channel,audit) in enumerate(report['global_FF_audit']['channels'].items()):
        coefficients=np.array([float(F(c)) for c in
            (audit['factored_polynomial_coefficients'] or audit['audited_coefficients'])])
        polynomial=np.polynomial.polynomial.polyval(z,coefficients)
        ratio=float(F(audit['rational_prefactor_excluding_pi5']))/np.pi**5*((1-x)/2)**float(F(audit['weight_power']))*abs(polynomial)**2
        axes[1].semilogx(energy,ratio,color=colors[j],label=channel)
    axes[1].axhline(1,color='black',lw=.8,ls='--')
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Energy (GeV)',ylabel='Squared-bound ratio',ylim=(0,1.08),title='Global FF bounds: certified')
    axes[1].legend(fontsize=8);axes[1].grid(alpha=.2)
    source=sol['same_color_source_comparison']['channels']['P1']
    axes[2].plot(source['energy_GeV'],source['source_phase_degrees'],'o-',ms=3,color='#cc668b',label='Published pink selection')
    axes[2].plot(source['energy_GeV'],source['computed_phase_degrees'],'-',color=colors[0],label='Current finite witness')
    axes[2].set(xlabel='Energy (GeV)',ylabel='P1 phase (degrees)',title='P1 phases: not reproduced')
    axes[2].legend(fontsize=8);axes[2].grid(alpha=.2)
    fig.savefig('results/global_ingredients.pdf');fig.savefig('results/global_ingredients.png',dpi=160)
    script=Path(__file__)
    Path('results/global_ingredients.metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(
        candidate=str(path),candidate_sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        script_source_utf8=script.read_text(),script_sha256=hashlib.sha256(script.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        scope='Curves display a fixed candidate. Global certificates are archived separately; finite scattering still violates unitarity. Source phases are explicit comparison targets, never fitted inputs of this witness.'),indent=2)+'\n')


if __name__=='__main__':main()
